so001.e: コーヒーを のんで から: after drinking coffee.
so001.t: Every morning, after drinking coffee, I go to school.

so002.e: つくえの 上に ペンが あります.
so002.t: There is a pen on the desk.

so003.e: デパートで かった シャツ: the shirt I bought at the department store.
so003.t: This is the shirt I bought at the department store yesterday.

so004.e: えきの ちかくの レストランで.
so004.t: A: "Where will you have lunch?" B: "At a restaurant near the station."

so005.e: わたしの へやは この ビルの ３かいです.
so005.t: My room is on the third floor of this building.

so006.e: せが たかくて かみが ながい.
so006.t: Yamada is a tall person with long hair.

so007.e: ともだちと いっしょに えいがを みました.
so007.t: Yesterday I watched a movie with a friend.

so008.e: ほんを よんだり テレビを みたり.
so008.t: A: "What did you do on Sunday?" B: "I read books and watched TV at home."

so009.e: この くつは ちょっと おおきいです.
so009.t: These shoes are a little big.

so010.e: たべた あとで さんぽに いきます.
so010.t: After eating dinner, I go for a walk.

so011.e: AとBと どちらが すきですか.
so011.t: Which do you like better, coffee or tea?

so012.e: せんせいに かりた かさ: the umbrella I borrowed from the teacher.
so012.t: A: "Whose umbrella is this?" B: "That's an umbrella I borrowed from the teacher."

so013.e: あるいて １０ぷん ぐらい かかります.
so013.t: It takes about 10 minutes to walk to the station.

so014.e: にほんの うたを うたう.

so015.e: あめが ふって いますから.
so015.t: It's raining today, so I'm staying at home.

so016.e: しゃしんを とっても いいですか.

so017.e: くにへ かえって かぞくに あう つもりです.
so017.t: A: "What will you do during the summer holidays?" B: "I plan to go back to my country and see my family."

so018.e: あまり おいしく ないです.

so019.e: でんきを けして から ねます.
so019.t: I turn off the light in my room and then go to bed.

so020.e: くだものの なかで りんごが いちばん すき.
so020.t: Of all fruits, I like apples best.

so021.e: しんぶんを よんで いる ひと.
so021.t: A: "Which person is Tanaka?" B: "The person reading a newspaper over there."

so022.e: ぎんこうで はたらいて いる かいしゃいん.
so022.t: My older brother is an office worker who works at a bank.

so023.e: ふじさんに のぼった ことが ありません.
so023.t: I have never climbed Mt. Fuji yet.

so024.e: テレビを みながら ごはんを たべます.
so024.t: My mother eats while watching TV.

so025.e: Tricky one: かった ばかりの かさを なくしました (I lost the umbrella I had just bought).
so025.t: I lost the umbrella I had just bought yesterday.

so026.e: まっすぐ いって つぎの かどを みぎに.
so026.t: Please go straight along this road and turn right at the next corner.

so027.e: バスで ２０ぷん ぐらい.
so027.t: From my house to the station it's about 20 minutes by bus.

so028.e: つめたい ものが のみたいです.
so028.t: A: "Would you like something to drink?" B: "Yes, I'd like something cold."

so029.e: ひとが たくさん きて いました.
so029.t: A lot of people came to yesterday's party.

so030.e: わたしに かわいい ペンを くれました.
so030.t: My younger sister gave me a cute pen.

so031.e: この かんじの よみかたを.
so031.t: Teacher, please tell me how to read this kanji.

so032.e: あたらしい くるまが ほしいです.

so033.e: こどもたちが あそんで います.
so033.t: Children are playing in the park.

so034.e: しゅくだいを して いて ２じに ねました.
so034.t: A: "What time did you go to bed yesterday?" B: "I was doing my homework, so I went to bed at 2."

so035.e: まいばん にほんごの ＣＤを ききます.
so035.t: I listen to a Japanese CD every night.

so036.e: ゆうびんきょくは どこに ありますか.
so036.t: Excuse me, where is the post office?

so037.e: めがねを かけて いる ひと.
so037.t: That person wearing glasses is Yamada.

so038.e: つかれたので はやく ねます.
so038.t: I'm tired today, so I'll go to bed early.

so039.e: きのう ともだちに てがみを かきました.
so039.t: Yesterday I wrote a letter to a friend.

so040.e: おくさんは りょうりが じょうず.
so040.t: Tanaka's wife is a good cook.

so041.e: ははが つくった ケーキです.
so041.t: A: "Who made this cake?" B: "It's a cake my mother made."

so042.t: I study a lot before tests.

so043.e: えきの まえに あたらしい みせが できました.
so043.t: A new shop has opened in front of the station.

so044.e: にほんごを はなすのが じょうず.
so044.t: Yamada is good at speaking Japanese.

so045.e: あさごはんを たべないで かいしゃへ.
so045.t: I went to the office without eating breakfast.

so046.e: かいだんの よこに あります.
so046.t: A: "Excuse me, where is the restroom?" B: "It's next to those stairs."

so047.e: くるまを とめては いけません.
so047.t: You must not park your car here.

so048.e: しゅみは しゃしんを とる ことです.

so049.e: ともだちの うちへ あそびに.
so049.t: Yesterday I went over to a friend's house.

so050.e: わたしが はじめて かいた え.
so050.t: This is the first picture I ever drew.

so051.e: およぎに いきたいと おもって います.
so051.t: I'm thinking of going swimming in the sea during the summer holidays.

so052.e: まいあさ しんぶんを よんで から.
so052.t: Every morning my father reads the newspaper before going out.

so053.e: あねが かって くれた かばん.
so053.t: A: "That's a nice bag." B: "Thanks. It's a bag my older sister bought for me."

so054.e: やすくて おいしいので いつも.
so054.t: This restaurant is cheap and good, so it's always crowded.

so055.e: にほんで はたらきたいと おもって います.
so055.t: I'm thinking that I'd like to work in Japan.

so056.e: いま でんわで はなして います.
so056.t: Tanaka is talking on the phone now.

so057.e: いぬと いっしょに こうえんを さんぽします.
so057.t: A: "What do you usually do on weekends?" B: "I walk in the park with my dog."

so058.e: この ほんは としょかんで かりました.
so058.t: I borrowed this book from the library.

so059.e: くつを ぬいで へやに はいりました.
so059.t: I took off my shoes and went into the room.

so060.e: さむいですから コートを.
so060.t: It's cold outside, so I'll wear a coat.

so061.e: いっしょに テニスを しませんか.
so061.t: Would you like to play tennis together tomorrow?

so062.t: We have two dogs at home, so it's very lively.

so063.e: あの あかい セーターを きて いる ひと.
so063.t: A: "Which person is Tanaka?" B: "The person wearing that red sweater."

so064.e: ばんごはんの あとで しゅくだいを.
so064.t: Every day I do my homework after dinner.

so065.e: きょねん だいがくを でて.
so065.t: My older brother graduated from university last year and works for a bank.

so066.e: もう すこし ゆっくり はなして ください.
so066.t: Excuse me, please speak a little more slowly.

so067.e: いぬより ねこの ほうが すき.
so067.t: I like cats better than dogs.

so068.e: この へやに だれも いません.
so068.t: There is nobody in this room.

so069.e: ともだちから かりた ペン.
so069.t: A: "Could you lend me that pen?" B: "Sorry, it's a pen I borrowed from a friend."

so070.e: にほんの なつは とても あつい.
so070.t: Summer in Japan is very hot.

so071.e: かんたんな てがみを かく ことが できます.
so071.t: I can write simple letters in Japanese.

so072.e: かぜを ひいて がっこうを やすみました.
so072.t: Yamada caught a cold and stayed home from school.

so073.e: しごとが たくさん あって.
so073.t: I have a lot of work today, so I'm busy.

so074.e: きのう かった ほんを.
so074.t: A: "What are you looking for?" B: "I'm looking for the book I bought yesterday."

so075.e: まいにち にほんごの しんぶん.
so075.t: I read a Japanese newspaper every day.

so076.e: うえに りんごが みっつ.
so076.t: There are three apples on the table.

so077.e: やさいを たくさん たべなさいと.
so077.t: My mother told me to eat lots of vegetables.

so078.e: あの しろい たてものは びょういんです.
so078.t: That white building over there is a hospital.

so079.e: こどもの とき よく かわで.
so079.t: When I was a child, I often swam in the river.

so080.e: あたまが いたかった からです.
so080.t: A: "Why didn't you come yesterday?" B: "Because I had a headache."

so081.e: この カメラは ちいさくて かるい.
so081.t: This camera is small and light.

so082.e: らいしゅうの どようびに パーティーを.
so082.t: We're having a party next Saturday.

so083.e: にほんごの うたを おしえて くれました.
so083.t: Tanaka taught me a Japanese song.

so084.e: ほんを よむのが すき.

so085.e: ここから えきまで バスで.
so085.t: From here to the station it's five minutes by bus.

so086.e: まだですから いっしょに.
so086.t: A: "Have you had lunch yet?" B: "No, not yet, so let's eat together."

so087.e: ふって いる ときは.
so087.t: When it's raining, I go by bus.

so088.e: まいにち ７じかん ぐらい ねます.
so088.t: I sleep about seven hours every day.

so089.e: この てがみを ポストに いれて.
so089.t: Please put this letter in the mailbox.

so090.e: ピアノを ひくのが じょうず.
so090.t: My younger sister is good at playing the piano.

so091.e: きのう １０じ ごろ いえに.

so092.e: その みちを わたった ところに.
so092.t: A: "Is there a supermarket near here?" B: "Yes, right across that street."

so093.e: ちちの たんじょうびに ネクタイを.
so093.t: I gave my father a tie for his birthday.

so094.e: きのう かった パンは あまり.
so094.t: The bread I bought yesterday wasn't very good.

so095.e: あさ はやく おきるのが にがて.
so095.t: I'm not good at getting up early in the morning.

so096.e: Tricky one: あした かいぎが ある と つたえて.
so096.t: Please tell Tanaka that there's a meeting tomorrow.

so097.e: この くすりは ごはんを たべた あとで.
so097.t: Please take this medicine after eating.

so098.e: えいがを みに いきました.
so098.t: A: "What did you do on the weekend?" B: "I went to see a movie with a friend."

so099.e: へやは せまいですが あかるい.
so099.t: My room is small, but bright.

so100.e: きょねんの ふゆは あまり さむく なかった.

so101.e: あさ おきて すぐ シャワーを.
so101.t: In the morning I take a shower right after getting up.

so102.e: この みせの ケーキは.
so102.t: The cakes at this shop are very delicious.

so103.e: くすりを かいに いきます.
so103.t: A: "Where are you going?" B: "I'm going to buy some medicine."

so104.e: えきの まえで ともだちを.
so104.t: I'm waiting for a friend in front of the station.

so105.e: にほんで とった しゃしん.
so105.t: I'll show you the photos I took in Japan.

so106.e: いぬの さんぽに いきます.
so106.t: I'm going to take the dog for a walk.

so107.e: きのう かった くつは すこし.
so107.t: The shoes I bought yesterday are a little big.

so108.e: あの くろい かばんを.
so108.t: Yamada is carrying that black bag.

so109.e: Tricky one: きのうから よんで いる.
so109.t: A: "Is that book interesting?" B: "Yes, I've been reading it since yesterday, and it's interesting."

so110.e: この へやには まどが.
so110.t: This room doesn't have a single window.

so111.e: ここで しゃしんを とらないで.

so112.e: ばんごはんを つくって いる.
so112.t: I think my mother is making dinner in the kitchen.

so113.e: この でんしゃは とうきょうまで.
so113.t: Does this train go as far as Tokyo?

so114.e: Tricky one: ねる まえに いつも ほんを よみます.
so114.t: I always read a book before going to bed.

so115.e: わたしは カレーに します.
so115.t: A: "What will you have for lunch?" B: "I'll have curry."

so116.e: ふって きたから かさを.
so116.t: It's started to rain, so please lend me an umbrella.

so117.e: いえは この みちの さき.
so117.t: Tanaka's house is further along this road.

so118.e: まいにち にほんごで にっきを.
so118.t: I keep a diary in Japanese every day.

so119.e: Tricky one: かどを みぎに まがると.
so119.t: If you turn right at that corner, you'll find the station.

so120.e: ともだちと いっしょに きょうとへ.
so120.t: Last year I went to Kyoto with a friend.
